summary: Implemented IK (intuitionistic modal K) soundness + completeness over birelational semantics as a single new file, IK.lean, instantiating the task-480 framework wholesale. Phase 1: IKModalAxiom datatype (9 intuitionistic propositional schemata + 5 modal schemata k1-k5) discharging the 480 framework's five modal hypotheses {h_K, h_Kdia, h_Cd, h_Idb, h_dbot} one-to-one. Phase 2: ik_soundness_derivable, the birelational soundness proof by structural induction on DerivationTree IKModalAxiom -- the only genuinely new proof (k/kdia/cd need no frame condition; idb consumes BFrame.f2 down-confluence; dbot is vacuous under IValid's fixed botForces = fun _ => False). Phase 3: ik_completeness/ik_consistent/ik_soundness_completeness as pure one-line instantiations of 480's ivalid_completeness, plus barrel registration. Zero-debt: no sorry/admit/new axiom; lean_verify confirms only the standard propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound trio on the completeness-side theorems and no axioms at all on the soundness side. Full CSLib CI pipeline passes (build, test, checkInitImports, lint-style all clean; lake shake's single IK.lean finding mirrors the pre-existing accepted 'import Cslib.Init' pattern shared by every sibling 480-framework file).
